sloka: निवेश्य गन्गाम् अनु ताम् महा नदीम् ।चमूम् विधानैः परिबर्ह शोभिनीम् ।उवास रामस्य तदा महात्मनो ।विचिन्तयानो भरतः निवर्तनम् ॥२-८३-२६॥
transliteration: niveśya gangām anu tām mahā nadīm ।camūm vidhānaiḥ paribarha śobhinīm ।uvāsa rāmasya tadā mahātmano ।vicintayāno bharataḥ nivartanam ॥2-83-26॥

translations.english: The army encamped by Bharata looked splendid with royal insigaia. After making necessary arrangements for the army on the bank of the mighty river Ganga and pondering over the means of bringing back the magnanimous Rama, Bharata stayed. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे त्र्यशीतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eightythird sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
